title: Process built-in function hash insertion, reset, and lifecycle registration

scope.rationale: These entities own the process-global built-in function hash, overload insertion, and the registration entry invoked by sqlite3_initialize before PCache and OS initialization. Production initialization now resets and rebuilds all 178 active-profile definitions under the coordinator's recursive initialization lock, with no extra name/arity pairs and exact pinned-C hash-head/overload topology. The two load-extension and nine ALTER TABLE records use explicit erroring fallback callbacks pending callable-body integration.
excluded_responsibilities: Individual scalar, aggregate, window, date/time, JSON, LIKE, math, and ALTER TABLE function bodies
Connection-local application-defined function creation and destruction
Function overload lookup and match-quality selection

external_source_responsibilities: Callable bodies for the two load-extension definitions and nine ALTER TABLE internal definitions
dependencies.caller_closure: The public and auto-initializing production paths install one initializer callback before entering the process coordinator. The outer lifecycle attempt invokes it before PCache and OS initialization; recursive and already-initialized calls do not rebuild the table.

inputs: Mutable static FuncDef definitions and an empty process-global function hash during outer initialization
outputs: Case-insensitive name-hash chains whose entries link same-name overloads through pNext
contracts.ownership: Definitions are static mutable records. Hash heads and links borrow those records and become read-only after successful initialization.
contracts.state_and_results: Every outer initialization attempt clears the hash before registration. Same-name definitions extend the overload chain; a new name prepends one hash head. Registration does not allocate or fail.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: The top-level coordinator invokes reset and registration while holding its recursive initialization mutex. No allocation or I/O occurs.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: A later lifecycle failure leaves the built-in table populated. Retry clears and deterministically rebuilds all heads and mutable links without cycles or duplicates.

representation_differences: The C global is an uninitialized static FuncDefHash cleared with memset; Zig assigns the typed zero-valued initial_builtin_functions constant.

C inserts ALTER TABLE, window, date/time, JSON, then core arrays. Zig keeps one mutable ported_definitions array and an exact source_registration_order permutation for all callback-backed window, date/time, JSON/JSONB, inline, LIKE, math, percentile, aggregate, and core definitions; all 178 records participate in exact source order; 11 records retain explicit erroring fallback callbacks pending callable-body integration.
The coordinator receives the registry initializer as a typed function pointer so the foundational global module does not import the full VDBE/function implementation graph.

oracle.protocol: The pinned C worker initializes the full source table, normalizes static callback/data addresses, and emits every bucket, hash head, overload, arity, flag word, and integer user-data value. The native worker resets and traverses the 178-definition production table through a callback bridge; byte-exact differential output establishes exact complete-table topology. Native tests also enforce finite rebuilds and representative flags/user data, while the broad suite exercises repeated initialization, shutdown, retry, prepared built-ins, and internal function lookup.
internal_observations: one occurrence for every ported definition
oracle.normalization: Function/data pointer addresses above 255 are normalized to zero. Bucket order, hash-head order, overload order, name, arity, flags, integer user data, installed-definition count, lookup, lifecycle ordering, and continuation are exact for the complete 178-definition table.

assurance.oom: Reset and insertion allocate nothing; function bodies and connection-local function allocation are outside scope.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O. Production rebuild is serialized by the process initialization owner; concurrent public initialization is covered by the global lifecycle tests.
assurance.malformed_input: Definitions are compile-time-owned records with non-null names; insertion assertions and finite-chain tests cover structural misuse.
assurance.continuation: Repeated rebuild and lifecycle retry preserve finite deterministic chains.
assurance.performance: Insertion is linear in definitions plus short name/overload chains, matching the source table construction strategy.

integration.production_owner: src/core/internal/function_registry.zig process hash and src/core/global.zig lifecycle callback
integration.native_call_path: public_api auto-initializing entry -> global.initializeProcessWithBuiltins -> Coordinator.initialize -> resetAndRegisterPortedBuiltinFunctions -> insertBuiltinFunctions
integration.bounded_owner_retired: Public initialization no longer performs registration after process initialization; registration is now ordered inside the process lifecycle before PCache and OS initialization.

independent_review.notes: Requires callable bodies for the 11 fallback load-extension/ALTER records and independent review.

known_blockers: Replace the explicit erroring fallbacks with callable bodies for the two load-extension and nine ALTER TABLE internal records.

implementation_spans: upstream/sqlite/src/global.c:303-309 was reviewed for the process-global zero-initialized FuncDefHash owner

upstream/sqlite/src/callback.c:331-380 was reviewed completely for hash lookup adjacency, insertion hash calculation, same-name overload linkage, new-name head insertion, assertions, and no-allocation behavior
upstream/sqlite/src/func.c:3266-3469 was reviewed completely for the mutable full definition table, selected-profile registrars, insertion order, and diagnostic-only hash dump
src/core/internal/function_registry.zig, vdbe_types.zig, global.zig, public_api.zig, and sql_frontend.zig owners and all lifecycle call sites were reviewed
callers: sqlite3_initialize clears the global hash and invokes sqlite3RegisterBuiltinFunctions before PCache initialization
sqlite3FindFunction and compiler analysis read the immutable hash after initialization
Every public auto-initializing entry converges on the callback-configured coordinator; same-thread recursion returns without rebuilding
callees: Registration invokes ALTER TABLE, window, date/time, and JSON registrars before inserting the core array
sqlite3InsertBuiltinFuncs hashes folded first byte plus bounded name length, finds a same-name head, links overloads through pNext, or prepends a new hash-chain head

The Zig reset owner clears typed hash heads and rebuilds 178 static records in source registrar/definition order, including all active inline/test-inline, C99 math, JSON/JSONB, date/time, window/lead/lag, LIKE, percentile, aggregate, and ordinary callback-backed definitions; load-extension and ALTER records retain explicit erroring fallback callbacks
assertions_branches_cleanup: All four insertion behavior IDs cover the definition loop, built-in assertion, same-name branch, and duplicate-link assertion
Static definition links are mutable only during initialization and borrowed thereafter
Retry must clear stale heads and reconstruct both pNext and pHash links without retaining cycles
No callable-body completion claim is made while 11 active-profile records retain fallback callbacks
upstream_tests: upstream func.test, func4.test, window tests, date tests, json tests, load-extension tests, and initialization/fault suites exercise registration and lookup

The builtin-registry differential compares all 178 definitions against the pinned C buckets, hash heads, overload chains, arities, flags, and integer user data; function-registry tests enforce finite rebuilds and representative values, while global lifecycle, SQL frontend, VDBE builder differential, and broad tests exercise lifecycle placement
